#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""A nightly installer page is published only for two passing development builds."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
os.environ.pop("X0X_NIGHTLY_REMOTE", None)

import dev_validate  # noqa: E402
import publish_nightly  # noqa: E402
import validation_inputs  # noqa: E402
from publish_nightly import LABEL, NightlyPublishError, publish_valid_nightly  # noqa: E402


def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=True).strip()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(message)


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def make_pkg(product, path):
    raw = bytearray(0x2000)
    for i, ch in enumerate(product[:20]):
        raw[i * 0x30 + 0x2F] = (ord(ch) + i + 1) & 0xFF
    for i in range(len(product), 20):
        raw[i * 0x30 + 0x2F] = 0x7D
    raw[0x400:0x415] = b"FELUCCA-LOADER-1"
    Path(path).write_bytes(raw)


def write_record(repo, model, fwsc, directory):
    """A record dev_validate.verify accepts. The publish gate re-checks it."""
    directory.mkdir()
    commit = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    tree = dev_validate.tree(repo, commit)
    plan = {"base": commit, "scope": "fixture behavior",
            "checks": [{"reason": "changed fixture", "argv": [sys.executable, "test.py"]}]}
    build_log = "app code area 100 B, 40 B free\nRAM .data+.bss 40 B of 100; pool 100 B of 10000\n"
    (directory / "build.log").write_text(build_log)
    (directory / "check-0.log").write_text("affected test passed\n")
    inputs = {
        "schema": validation_inputs.SCHEMA,
        "mode": "dev",
        "source": tree,
        "configuration": {
            "model": model, "config": "dev", "controller": False,
            "plan": plan, "dependencies": [],
        },
    }
    data = {
        "schema": 2,
        "validation_inputs": {
            "schema": validation_inputs.SCHEMA,
            "sha256": validation_inputs.digest(validation_inputs.encoded(inputs)),
            "inputs": inputs,
        },
        "result": "DEV CHECKED",
        "config": "dev",
        "model": model,
        "commit": commit,
        "tree": tree,
        "plan": plan,
        "controller": False,
        "budgets": dev_validate.budgets(build_log),
        "logs": {
            "build": {"returncode": 0, "sha256": digest(directory / "build.log")},
            "check-0": {"returncode": 0, "sha256": digest(directory / "check-0.log")},
        },
        "artifacts": {"package": {"file": Path(fwsc).name, "sha256": digest(fwsc)}},
    }
    record = directory / "record.json"
    record.write_text(json.dumps(data))
    checked = dev_validate.verify(repo, commit, record, fwsc)
    require(checked["model"] == model, "fixture record did not verify")
    return record


def refused(message, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except NightlyPublishError as error:
        require(message in str(error), f"expected {message!r} in {error}")
        return
    raise SystemExit("invalid nightly was published")


def main():
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="nightly-publish-"))
    repo = tmp / "repo"
    repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], cwd=repo)
    (repo / "notes.txt").write_text("fixture\n")
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", "."])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t",
                           "commit", "-qm", "fixture"])
    elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc = tmp / "elite.fwsc", tmp / "pro.fwsc"
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Elite_900", elite_fwsc)
    make_pkg("SMK-37 Pro_900", pro_fwsc)
    elite_record = write_record(repo, "elite", elite_fwsc, tmp / "elite")
    pro_record = write_record(repo, "pro", pro_fwsc, tmp / "pro")
    commit = git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")

    page = tmp / "page"
    publish_valid_nightly(repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, page, push=False)
    catalog = json.loads((page / "versions.json").read_text())
    require(catalog["channel"] == "nightly" and catalog["importsReleases"] is False, "nightly catalog flags")
    require(catalog["latest"].startswith("nightly-"), catalog["latest"])
    version = catalog["versions"][0]
    require(version["label"] == LABEL and version["status"] == "dev-checked", "hardware-test label")
    require(version["hardware_tested"] is False and version["source_commit"] == commit, "source commit")
    require(set(version["models"]) == {"elite", "pro"}, "both models")
    for key, product in (("elite", "SMK-37 Elite_900"), ("pro", "SMK-37 Pro_900")):
        require(version["models"][key]["product"] == product, product)
        name = Path(version["models"][key]["pkg"]).name
        require((page / "firmware" / name).is_file(), name)
    install = (page / "install" / "index.html").read_text()
    landing = (page / "index.html").read_text()
    require("DEVICE NOT TESTED" in install and '"importsReleases":false' in install and '"channel":"nightly"' in install,
            "installer page")
    require(LABEL in landing and "failed or invalid build is not published" in landing, "landing banner")
    require("/*CATALOG*/" not in install, "catalog was not inlined")

    missing = tmp / "missing"
    refused("missing", lambda: publish_valid_nightly(
        repo, elite_record, tmp / "no-record.json", elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, missing, push=False))
    require(not missing.exists(), "failed publish created a page")

    swapped = tmp / "swapped"
    refused("not a passing", lambda: publish_valid_nightly(
        repo, pro_record, elite_record, pro_fwsc, elite_fwsc, swapped, push=False))
    require(not swapped.exists(), "swapped models were published")

    tampered = tmp / "tampered.fwsc"
    raw = bytearray(elite_fwsc.read_bytes())
    raw[-1] ^= 0x01
    tampered.write_bytes(raw)
    bad_pkg = tmp / "bad-pkg"
    refused("did not pass", lambda: publish_valid_nightly(
        repo, elite_record, pro_record, tampered, pro_fwsc, bad_pkg, push=False))
    require(not bad_pkg.exists(), "tampered package was published")

    failed = json.loads(elite_record.read_text())
    failed["result"] = "FAILED"
    failed_path = tmp / "failed-record.json"
    failed_path.write_text(json.dumps(failed))
    failed_out = tmp / "failed-out"
    refused("not a passing", lambda: publish_valid_nightly(
        repo, failed_path, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, failed_out, push=False))
    require(not failed_out.exists(), "failed record was published")

    bare = tmp / "bare.git"
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "nightly-pages", str(bare)])
    pushed = tmp / "pushed"
    publish_valid_nightly(repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, pushed,
                          remote=str(bare), push=True)
    published = git(bare, "rev-parse", "nightly-pages")
    clone = tmp / "clone"
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "clone", "-q", "-b", "nightly-pages", str(bare), str(clone)])
    require((clone / "install" / "index.html").is_file(), "pushed installer")
    require("ctl.img" not in [path.name for path in (clone / "firmware").iterdir()], "controller image was hosted")
    first_handoff = json.loads((pushed / "handoff.json").read_text())
    require(first_handoff["live_deploy"] is False, "first handoff claimed a live deploy")
    require(first_handoff["pages_repository"] == "gobbajogger/x0x37-for-Loopy-Pro_nightly", "pages repo")
    require(first_handoff["pages_ref"] == "gh-pages", "pages ref")
    require("PUBLISHED LIVE" not in (pushed / "handoff.json").read_text(), "published-live claim")
    (repo / "second.txt").write_text("second candidate\n")
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(repo), "add", "second.txt"])
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t",
                           "commit", "-qm", "second"])
    elite_again = write_record(repo, "elite", elite_fwsc, tmp / "elite-again")
    pro_again = write_record(repo, "pro", pro_fwsc, tmp / "pro-again")
    pushed_again = tmp / "pushed-again"
    publish_valid_nightly(repo, elite_again, pro_again, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, pushed_again,
                          remote=str(bare), push=True)
    again = git(bare, "rev-parse", "nightly-pages")
    require(again != published, "second handoff did not move the branch")
    require(git(bare, "rev-parse", "nightly-pages^") == published, "second handoff is not a child of the first")
    subprocess.check_call(["git", "-C", str(bare), "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", published, again])
    again_catalog = json.loads((pushed_again / "versions.json").read_text())
    again_names = {item["version"] for item in again_catalog["versions"]}
    require(catalog["latest"] in again_names, "first candidate was dropped: " + str(again_names))
    require(again_catalog["latest"] in again_names and again_catalog["latest"] != catalog["latest"],
            "second candidate missing")
    again_handoff = json.loads((pushed_again / "handoff.json").read_text())
    require(again_handoff["live_deploy"] is False, "second handoff claimed a live deploy")
    require("gh-pages" not in git(bare, "show-ref"), "separate repo gained a gh-pages ref")
    blocked = tmp / "blocked"
    refused("gh-pages", lambda: publish_valid_nightly(
        repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, blocked,
        remote=str(bare), push=True, branch="gh-pages"))
    require(git(bare, "rev-parse", "nightly-pages") == again, "refused push moved the nightly branch")
    require(not blocked.exists(), "refused branch wrote a page")
    for branch in ("main", "master", "nightly"):
        refused(branch, lambda branch=branch: publish_valid_nightly(
            repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, tmp / ("out-" + branch),
            remote=str(bare), push=True, branch=branch))
    require(publish_nightly._destination("refs/heads/nightly-pages") == "nightly-pages",
            "qualified nightly-pages ref")
    calls = []
    real_run = publish_nightly.subprocess.run

    def spy(args, *a, **k):
        argv = list(args)
        calls.append(argv)
        if "push" in argv:
            raise AssertionError("git push reached: " + " ".join(map(str, argv)))
        return real_run(args, *a, **k)

    publish_nightly.subprocess.run = spy
    try:
        for branch in ("refs/heads/main", "refs/heads/gh-pages", "refs/heads/master", "refs/heads/nightly"):
            out = tmp / ("qualified-" + branch.replace("/", "-"))
            refused(branch.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], lambda branch=branch, out=out: publish_valid_nightly(
                repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, out,
                remote=str(bare), push=True, branch=branch))
            require(not out.exists(), "qualified ref wrote a page: " + branch)
    finally:
        publish_nightly.subprocess.run = real_run
    require(not any("push" in cmd for cmd in calls), "qualified ref reached git push: " + repr(calls))
    require(git(bare, "rev-parse", "nightly-pages") == again, "qualified ref moved the nightly branch")

    previous = json.loads((page / "versions.json").read_text())
    older = json.loads(json.dumps(previous["versions"][0]))
    older["version"] = "nightly-older"
    broken = {
        "version": "broken", "label": LABEL, "status": "failed", "config": "dev",
        "hardware_tested": False, "source_commit": commit, "models": older["models"],
    }
    previous["versions"].extend([older, broken])
    (page / "versions.json").write_text(json.dumps(previous))
    (page / "firmware" / "nope.fwsc").write_bytes(b"not a package")
    merged = tmp / "merged"
    publish_valid_nightly(repo, elite_record, pro_record, elite_fwsc, pro_fwsc, merged,
                          merge=page, push=False)
    merged_catalog = json.loads((merged / "versions.json").read_text())
    names = {item["version"] for item in merged_catalog["versions"]}
    require(names == {catalog["latest"], "nightly-older"}, names)
    require("broken" not in (merged / "install" / "index.html").read_text(), "failed build listed")
    require(not (merged / "firmware" / "nope.fwsc").exists(), "unrelated firmware copied")

    cli = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "tools" / "publish_nightly.py"),
         "--repo", str(repo), "--elite-record", str(failed_path), "--elite-fwsc", str(elite_fwsc),
         "--pro-record", str(pro_record), "--pro-fwsc", str(pro_fwsc), "--out", str(tmp / "cli")],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    require(cli.returncode == 2 and not (tmp / "cli").exists(), cli.stderr)
    shell = subprocess.run(
        ["sh", str(ROOT / "tools" / "publish_pages.sh"), "--nightly",
         "--repo", str(repo), "--elite-record", str(elite_record), "--elite-fwsc", str(elite_fwsc),
         "--pro-record", str(pro_record), "--pro-fwsc", str(pro_fwsc), "--out", str(tmp / "shell")],
        capture_output=True, text=True)
    require(shell.returncode == 0 and (tmp / "shell" / "install" / "index.html").is_file(),
            shell.stdout + shell.stderr)
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
    print("PASS nightly publish")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run the production service body with simulated mailbox, time and radio state.

The source root option permits negative controls in a scratch tree.
No device access occurs. Target interrupt timing is outside this test.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2])
parser.add_argument('case', nargs='?', choices=['stop', 'service', 'cancel'])
args = parser.parse_args()
root = args.source_root.resolve()
source = (root / 'firmware/src/ble.c').read_text()
start = source.index('static void ble_central_service(void)\n{')
end = source.index('\n}\n', start) + 3
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ble-deadline-') as directory:
    scratch = Path(directory)
    (scratch / 'ble_central_service.inc').write_text(source[start:end])
    binary = scratch / 'deadline'
    subprocess.run([os.environ.get('CC', 'cc'), '-std=c99', '-g', '-O1', '-Wall',
                    '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-fsanitize=address,undefined',
                    '-fno-sanitize-recover=all', '-I' + str(scratch),
                    str(root / 'tests/host/ble_midi_deadline_test.c'),
                    str(root / 'firmware/src/ble/ble_midi_central.c'), '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(binary)] + ([args.case] if args.case else []), check=True)

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Production storage fault tests and byte comparison with the reviewed baseline.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
OUT=${OUT:-build/host/storage-scratch}
mkdir -p "$OUT"
ST_BASELINE=${ST_BASELINE:-e75fb2a584aa22978f352697a5e36fc9f886c3c5}
git show "$ST_BASELINE:firmware/src/storage.c" > "$OUT/baseline-storage.c"
BASELINE_SOURCE=$(cd "$OUT" && pwd)/baseline-storage.c
${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function ${SAN_FLAGS:-} \
    tests/storage_scratch_test.c -o "$OUT/faults"
"$OUT/faults"
${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O2 -DBOARD_SMK37=1 -DSTORAGE_SHARED=1 \
    tests/storage_bytes_test.c -o "$OUT/current"
"$OUT/current" "$OUT/current-nor.bin"
${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O2 -DBOARD_SMK37=1 "-DSTORAGE_IMPL=\"$BASELINE_SOURCE\"" \
    tests/storage_bytes_test.c -o "$OUT/baseline"
"$OUT/baseline" "$OUT/baseline-nor.bin"
cmp "$OUT/current-nor.bin" "$OUT/baseline-nor.bin"
python3 - "$OUT/current-nor.bin" <<'PY'
import hashlib, pathlib, sys
print('Baseline/current complete synthetic NOR byte comparison PASS; sha256=' +
      hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY

#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# Install the gate (tools/gate.sh as x0x37_gate.sh, tools/gate_sigwrap.py, tools/gate_flashmap.py, tools/validation_inputs.py, tools/prepush-check.sh, tools/quickcheck.sh into the shared gate folder.
#   tools/install_gate.sh
# The install starts only when the gate lock is free (flock -n) AND no x0x37_gate.sh process runs (pgrep).
# It holds the lock during the install. Each file goes to a temp file in the same folder, gets mode 555 and
# replaces the old file with "mv -f" (a running bash never reads a half-written script). The folder mode is
# restored after the install. If the gate is busy, the script waits (5 s steps, at most X0X_INSTALL_WAIT seconds)
# and then stops with "NOT INSTALLED" and the reason. Exit code 0 (installed) or 1.
# Environment (defaults in brackets): X0X_GATE_DEST [/workspace/x0x37-refs/gate]
#   X0X_GATE_LOCK [/workspace/x0x37-refs/gate.lock]  X0X_INSTALL_WAIT [1800]
set -u
SRC=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
DEST=${X0X_GATE_DEST:-/workspace/x0x37-refs/gate}
GLOCK=${X0X_GATE_LOCK:-/workspace/x0x37-refs/gate.lock}
MAX=${X0X_INSTALL_WAIT:-1800}
for f in gate.sh gate_sigwrap.py gate_flashmap.py validation_inputs.py prepush-check.sh quickcheck.sh quickcheck_plan.py pre-push.hook; do [ -f "$SRC/$f" ] || { echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED: no $SRC/$f"; exit 1; }; done
bash -n "$SRC/gate.sh" || { echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED: syntax error in $SRC/gate.sh"; exit 1; }
[ -d "$DEST" ] || { echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED: no folder $DEST"; exit 1; }
exec 9>>"$GLOCK" || { echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED: cannot open $GLOCK"; exit 1; }
T0=$(date +%s); SAID=""
while :; do
    WHY=""
    if ! flock -n 9; then WHY="the gate lock $GLOCK is held"
    else
        RUN=$(pgrep -af '/?x0x37_gate\.sh( |$)' | grep -v -e pgrep -e install_gate)
        [ -z "$RUN" ] || { WHY="a gate runs: $(echo "$RUN" | head -1 | cut -c1-120)"; flock -u 9; }
    fi
    [ -z "$WHY" ] && break
    if [ $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) -ge "$MAX" ]; then
        echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED after $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) s: $WHY"; exit 1
    fi
    [ "$SAID" = "$WHY" ] || { echo "install_gate: waiting ($WHY)" >&2; SAID=$WHY; }
    sleep 5
done
# the lock is held and no gate runs
P0=$(stat -c %a "$DEST")
chmod u+w "$DEST" || { echo "install_gate: NOT INSTALLED: cannot write $DEST"; exit 1; }
ok=1
for p in "gate.sh x0x37_gate.sh" "gate_sigwrap.py gate_sigwrap.py" "gate_flashmap.py gate_flashmap.py" "validation_inputs.py validation_inputs.py" "prepush-check.sh prepush-check.sh" "quickcheck.sh quickcheck.sh" "quickcheck_plan.py quickcheck_plan.py" "pre-push.hook pre-push.hook"; do
    set -- $p
    t="$DEST/.$2.new.$$"
    cp "$SRC/$1" "$t" && chmod 555 "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$DEST/$2" && cmp -s "$SRC/$1" "$DEST/$2" || { ok=0; rm -f "$t"; }
done
chmod "$P0" "$DEST"
flock -u 9; exec 9>&-
[ "$ok" = 1 ] || { echo "install_gate: FAILED: a file did not install (see $DEST)"; exit 1; }
echo "install_gate: INSTALLED $(sha256sum "$DEST/x0x37_gate.sh" | cut -c1-12) x0x37_gate.sh, $(sha256sum "$DEST/gate_sigwrap.py" | cut -c1-12) gate_sigwrap.py, $(sha256sum "$DEST/gate_flashmap.py" | cut -c1-12) gate_flashmap.py, $(sha256sum "$DEST/prepush-check.sh" | cut -c1-12) prepush-check.sh, $(sha256sum "$DEST/quickcheck.sh" | cut -c1-12) quickcheck.sh in $DEST (folder mode $P0, waited $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) s)"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""One owner for each press of "<" and ">" in clip mode (BEHAVIOR.md CLP-27, CLP-76, GEN-56).
A menu list open: only smk_arrows acts (ui_menu_open), and the clip keys (ck_controls) mask the arrows.
No menu: smk_arrows does nothing in clip mode, and the clip keys page step stays as it is.
The test reads the source, because the clip keys code needs the device build. It also checks that the
two hold repeats use the same times."""
import re
import sys

ROOT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "."
main = open(f"{ROOT}/firmware/src/app/main_fm1.c").read()
ui = open(f"{ROOT}/firmware/src/app/ui.c").read()
arw = open(f"{ROOT}/firmware/src/app/smk_arrows.h").read()
ckh = open(f"{ROOT}/firmware/src/app/smk_clip_keys.h").read()


def body(src, head):
    i = src.index(head)
    j = src.index("\n}\n", i)
    return src[i:j]


def define(src, name):
    m = re.search(rf"#define {name} (\d+)u", src)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


# the clip keys own the knobs and the arrows only with no menu (no list, no question, no help card)
own = body(main, "uint8_t smk_ck_knobs_owned(void)")
assert "ui.overlay == O_NONE" in own, own
# smk_arrows takes the arrows only with a menu list open
assert "ui.overlay == O_LIST" in body(ui, "static int ui_menu_open(void)")
sa = body(main, "static void smk_arrows(void)")
assert "arw_route((uint32_t)ui_menu_open(), clip_grid_mode" in sa, sa
assert re.search(r"if \(route == ARW_MENU\) \{\s*ui_menu_arrow\(d\);", sa), sa
assert "return home ? ARW_NONE : menu ? ARW_MENU : clip ? ARW_NONE : ARW_SELECT;" in arw
# the clip keys: the arrow presses are masked when they do not own the controls
ck = body(main, "CK_FN static void ck_controls(void)")
assert re.search(r"if \(!(own|smk_ck_knobs_owned\(\))\)\s*press &= ~0x60u;", ck), "ck_controls must mask < > with a menu"
if "ck_rpt(" in ck:                      # e7989ac: the hold repeat reads the held arrows: only when owned
    arg = ck[ck.index("ck_rpt(") + 7:]
    assert re.match(r"(own|smk_ck_knobs_owned\(\)) &&", arg), "ck_rpt must get 0 with a menu open"
else:                                    # before e7989ac: a press steps the page
    assert "press & 0x60u" in ck
# no other read of the held arrows (cur bits 5-6) in ck_controls
held = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"cur >> 5|cur & 0x60", ck)]
assert len(held) <= ("ck_rpt(" in ck), "an unmasked read of the held < >"
# the same feel: the same hold repeat times
assert define(arw, "ARW_FIRST_MS") == 400 and define(arw, "ARW_NEXT_MS") == 80
if define(ckh, "CK_RPT_DELAY") is not None:
    assert define(ckh, "CK_RPT_DELAY") == define(arw, "ARW_FIRST_MS")
    assert define(ckh, "CK_RPT_MS") == define(arw, "ARW_NEXT_MS")
print("smk_arrows_owner: ok")
